يستحيوا (form X)
# يَسْتَحْيُوا (yastaḥyū) /jas.taħ.juː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْيَا (istaḥyā)
# يُسْتَحْيَوْا (yustaḥyaw) /jus.taħ.jaw/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْيَا (istaḥyā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
